Dear Cedar HCP Office,

We are following up on synthetic case ACC-2086. The Juniper Plan insurance card image you submitted is unreadable, and no corrected identifier is recorded. To proceed with benefit verification we need either a legible copy of the insurance card or a confirmed member identifier sent via your established secure channel.

Once we receive a legible card or a confirmed member identifier, we can submit the benefit-verification inquiry. Please note that submitting the inquiry is an administrative step; it is not a coverage approval or prior-authorization decision.

If you prefer, reply here after you upload the clearer card or send the identifier and we will continue the administrative process.

Thank you,
Morgan Lee
Field Reimbursement Manager

trace.question: Draft a patient-friendly status update.

response.answer: Below is a patient-friendly status update you can review and send.

workProduct.body:
Hello Taylor,

Thanks for completing the enrollment form. We have received your enrollment and Birch Specialty Pharmacy has recorded the prescription intake. One item is still needed before the pharmacy can finish its administrative checks: the consent form is missing a signature.

Please complete the consent signature using the program’s established secure channel. Once the pharmacy receives and verifies the signed consent, they will complete their checks; only then can they confirm whether the prescription is dispense-ready and arrange shipment. At this time there is no dispense release, shipment confirmation, carrier handoff, or tracking number recorded.

If you have clinical questions about your medication, please contact your treating clinician or the pharmacy pharmacist. If you’re unsure how to complete consent through the secure channel, let me know and I can explain the next steps.

Best regards,
Jordan Rivera
Willow Support
